items.title: Higher pro-etale cohomology of the pullback of an injective sheaf on an affine scheme vanishes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for an affine scheme X and an injective abelian sheaf I on the small etale site, the higher pro-etale cohomology of the pullback of I vanishes (statement lines 4082-4087). The proof (proof lines 4089-4167) applies the Cech vanishing criterion: it verifies conditions (1) and (2) for a suitable set of affine objects and coverings, reduces pro-etale coverings to filtered colimits of etale coverings, approximates an etale covering by etale coverings of an etale approximation of the base, and concludes by the acyclicity of the Cech complex of an injective sheaf. H3: an original reduction of pro-etale coverings to etale ones combined with a limit approximation, all written out in full.
